name: 到期管家
description: Track recurring due dates and Apple Reminders in native-style widgets with compact interactive controls, continuous completion, animated queue updates, upcoming previews, and local intelligent SF Symbol matching.

localizedDescriptions.zh: 通过原生风格桌面组件管理信用卡、订阅、周期事项与提醒事项，支持紧凑交互控件、连续完成、动态队列补位、下一事项预告和本机智能图标。
